Headline results of agent run /home/hyoklee/poro/agent/results/run_20261115T155359Z_s20 (PoroTomo DAS, Brady Hot Springs, March 2016; read-only report via `python3 ~/poro/agent/report.py <run>`):

SCOPE / DATA
- Records analysed: 759 (stride 20), covering 2016-03-18T02:09:17Z to 2016-03-26T00:59:44Z (3.314% of the time window).
- Anomalous records (|robust z| > 5): 57.
- DAS detections: 62 detections in 53 records; relative b = 0.9849 (34 detections above the catalogue magnitude of completeness Mc).
- Pumping over 15.96 days: injected 4.654e+05 m3, extracted 5.059e+05 m3, net -4.048e+04 m3 (net extraction).
- Catalogue (GDR 859, LBNL/NCEDC March 2016): 5 events, ML -0.48 to 0.07.

CALIBRATED PROBABILITIES (catalogue-based, Shapiro et al. 2021 Eq. 5 — this is the calibrated estimate, anchored to the LBNL catalogue):
- b = 1.0:  Sigma = -5.449,  P(M>=5.5)/yr = 0.0001198  (P(M>=5.5) at observed volume = 5.236e-06; P(M>=3)/yr = 0.03719)
- b = 0.73: Sigma = -5.319,  P(M>=5.5)/yr = 0.004922   (P(M>=5.5) at observed volume = 0.0002155; P(M>=3)/yr = 0.2809)
- b = 0.65: Sigma = -5.281,  P(M>=5.5)/yr = 0.01474    (P(M>=5.5) at observed volume = 0.0006484; P(M>=3)/yr = 0.4653)

DAS-BASED UPPER BOUND (uncalibrated magnitudes; every DAS detection counted as an event at or above the catalogue Mc, so it OVER-COUNTS and is only an upper bound, not calibrated):
- b = 0.9849, Sigma = -2.698, P(M>=5.5)/yr = 0.07842.

INTERPRETATION: The calibrated catalogue-based probability of a Pohang-like Mw >= 5.5 event is at most ~1.5e-2 per year even for the lowest b scenario (b = 0.65) and as low as ~1.2e-4 per year for b = 1.0, i.e. very low. The DAS-based figure of 0.07842/yr is an upper bound only, because DAS magnitudes are uncalibrated and all 62 detections are counted as events above Mc, so it over-counts; the calibrated LBNL-catalogue numbers above are the reliable estimates.
